title: Following
description: Follow authors, reopen their public work from Following, and optionally weigh follows in For You.
content:
Following is how you keep up with people whose public hubs you want to see again. It is not a club membership and it does not unlock a paywall.

Primary action: Open Following

Where to find it

On a public profile, use Follow. Reopen the list at kahana.io/following. You need an account.

What it does

  • Keeps a list of authors you chose to follow.
  • Can weigh followed authors in the For You feed if that signal is on.
  • Does not grant paid hub access or club seats.

What’s next

  • Profiles
  • For You and taste
  • Saving and collections
